user.title: Connect to COSMOS
user.description: Enter your DEOS COSMOS controller's connection details.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read controller data. Check the address and ports.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme, port, or path.
error.invalid_port: Use a whole-number port between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_interval: Use a whole number of seconds between 1 and 300.
error.cannot_identify: Unable to read the controller's serial number. Check the system information port.

abort.wrong_device: The serial number does not match the configured controller.

reconfigure_required.message: Controller address is missing. Select Reconfigure to set it.

controller_serial_changed.message: The controller's serial number has changed. Check the address.
